description: Compute a coin ID from its three components: parent_coin_id (also accepted as parent_coin_info), puzzle_hash, and amount. The coin ID is SHA256(parent_coin_id + puzzle_hash + amount_bytes). Amount is encoded as a big-endian integer with minimal bytes. Pure local computation, no RPC call.

amount.description: The coin amount in mojos (use string for values > 9007199254740991)

parent_coin_id.description: The parent coin's ID (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex). Also accepted as parent_coin_info.

parent_coin_info.description: Alias for parent_coin_id — matches the field name used in coin records returned by the RPC.

puzzle_hash.description: The puzzle hash of this coin (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex)

name: coin_id
